name: Sun
description: The next two things the sun will do, for a position you set once. Sunrise and sunset side by side, nearest first, and how long until it. Nothing on the card is in the past. One glance in the carousel; tapping it opens nothing, because there is nothing more to say.

configFields.label: Latitude
configFields.description: Decimal degrees, north positive. 45.4215 is Ottawa. A position good to 25 km is good to under a minute of sunrise, so the nearest city is close enough.
configFields.validationMessage: Decimal degrees between -90 and 90, e.g. 45.4215. Not 45,4215 and not 45.4215N.

configFields.label: Longitude
configFields.description: Decimal degrees, east positive. -75.6972 is Ottawa. Take care not to swap it with the latitude: if both are valid latitudes nothing can catch it.
configFields.validationMessage: Decimal degrees between -180 and 180, e.g. -75.6972. Not -75,6972 and not 75.6972W.
